# Boilerplate

> Boilerplate pairs a Python development environment, one tool for each job, with templates that build on one another to stamp out projects. It takes care of the parts around writing code (a working toolchain and a configured project), so you start at the work.

Boilerplate pairs a Python development environment, one tool for each job, with templates that build on one another to stamp out projects. Each pick is the most modern and lightweight option for its job. These pages describe the tool at its current version. The status page maps what is implemented; the design section describes the target state, not what exists.

## Get started

- [Python projects from templates](https://therealbillsiegler.github.io/boilerplate/0.4/index.md): What Boilerplate is, with a recorded demo
- [Why Boilerplate](https://therealbillsiegler.github.io/boilerplate/0.4/why/index.md): The problem it removes and how it relates to Copier
- [Install](https://therealbillsiegler.github.io/boilerplate/0.4/install/index.md): Installing the toolchain and the CLI
- [Quickstart](https://therealbillsiegler.github.io/boilerplate/0.4/quickstart/index.md): Scaffold a project and run its checks
- [Status](https://therealbillsiegler.github.io/boilerplate/0.4/status/index.md): What is implemented, partial, and planned
